text:
Alex R: Quick async check-in — backend gateway canary rolled to 20% last night. Did: updated routing policy to prefer dedicated pool for heavy-gen requests. Blockers: still seeing occasional 429s on /v1/generate when seq len>1024, not sure if batching logic or token buckets.
Priya S: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the canary config? curious about burst settings.
Alex R: Here, pasted the canary config: 
```
gw-canary:
  route: /v1/generate
  weight: 0.2
  throttle:
    burst: 50
    rate: 25/s
```
Priya S: Hmm, burst 50 seems low for long-running streams; try bumping to 200? Also check kv-cache keys — if cache miss we hit higher token compute.
Mateo: Re: 429s — I saw p95 latency spikes correlated with small batching windows. Might be autoscaling lag.
Erin: I can pick up a short experiment to double the burst and monitor 429 rate. I'll add a small canary in staging first.
Alex R: Thanks Erin. If you add changes, ping me — I'll adjust the rollout to 5% then 20%.
deploy-bot: deploy dispatch:gw-canary v2 -> started by Erin at 2025-03-15T09:12:03Z
Jordan: FYI I opened CR #1943 to expose token-bucket metrics per route (cc @Priya S)
Priya S: Nice, that will help. Quick Q: any auth side effects with deduping? we had a small auth-failure bump during last run.
Alex R: No auth changes; dedupe only at ingress layer. But we did change header normalization — could be related. I'm rolling back header change in staging now.
Erin: Rollback done in staging, running load tests: `./scripts/load-test --route /v1/generate --concurrency 30`
Mateo: Results look better, 429s down ~70% in staging after bumping burst to 200.
Alex R: Great. Can someone do a small canary to prod at 5% tonight? If green, we'll promote. Also can we add an alert on token-bucket fill rate hitting 90% for >2m?
Priya S: I'll add alert in ops runbook and add to dashboard.
Jordan: I'll attach CR link: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/1943
Alex R: Thanks all. Blockers cleared for now — will follow up with post-mortem if any regressions. :thumbsup:
